component.name: Stonks
component.summary: Desktop stock tracker for Linux and macOS

description.p: Stonks is a lightweight desktop app for tracking stocks, ETFs, indices, crypto, and forex. Add any ticker to your watchlist and see live prices, daily change percentages, and interactive historical charts.

ul.li: Watchlist with live prices and daily change
Interactive price charts with multiple time ranges (1D to Max)
Key financial stats: P/E, market cap, 52-week range, and more
Supports stocks, ETFs, indices, crypto, and forex

screenshot.caption: Watchlist with price chart and financial stats
